pass_requires_gate_measurement.rule: sample_rate_Sa_s >= 100e3, bandwidth_Hz >= 20e3, anti_alias_documented and synchronized True, non-empty source

transient_window.fail_basis_assumption: step_average / steady_state bound P_bus,1ms,max from below only when the averaging duration is a whole multiple of 1 ms (exact) or much longer than 1 ms (approximate); an unstated basis gives NOT_EVALUABLE. A ledger is a SUM of per-slot values: on the p_bus_1ms_max basis that sum is a rigorous bound for FAIL only when the slot values are simultaneous (taken in the same 1 ms window, e.g. one system-level bus channel split by slot); a sum of per-slot 1 ms maxima taken at different times is an UPPER bound (conservative for PASS) but not a lower bound, so a FAIL on it must be confirmed by the system-level (bus-channel) 1 ms maximum (P1MS_SUM_RULE)
transient_window.p1ms_sum_rule: p_bus_1ms_max ledger: FAIL requires slot values from one common 1 ms window (system-level bus-channel maximum); summed non-simultaneous per-slot maxima support PASS (upper bound) but a FAIL on them is only an indication until the system-level 1 ms maximum confirms it
transient_window.peak_sampled_rule: an unaveraged sampled peak is a protection-analysis record, not the 1.5 kW gate (A9.1 OQ-A902-01): NOT_EVALUABLE in both directions; whether a conformant sampled peak below 1500 W may bound P_bus,1ms,max is the OPEN owner question OQ-A910-03 (not implemented before the owner rules)

A ledger is a SUM of per-slot values: on the p_bus_1ms_max basis that sum is a rigorous bound for FAIL only when the slot values are simultaneous (taken in the same 1 ms window, e.g. one system-level bus channel split by slot); a sum of per-slot 1 ms maxima taken at different times is an UPPER bound (conservative for PASS) but not a lower bound, so a FAIL on it must be confirmed by the system-level (bus-channel) 1 ms maximum (P1MS_SUM_RULE)

rfp_gate.p1ms_sum_rule: p_bus_1ms_max ledger: FAIL requires slot values from one common 1 ms window (system-level bus-channel maximum); summed non-simultaneous per-slot maxima support PASS (upper bound) but a FAIL on them is only an indication until the system-level 1 ms maximum confirms it

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: INCLUDES Xe + tank — use the conservative wet-system interpretation unless the official RFP explicitly defines the 40 kg as dry mass.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: 40 kg is wet: H2-7 mass demands for PPU/RF electronics are booked against the wet-system limit

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: SUPERSEDED numeric delta — do not carry 0.05/0.1 into the new architecture automatically. Define the new decision quantities first, then freeze any effect-size margin before score-bearing data.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: no numeric decision margin is carried; allocation checks are owner allocations, not effect sizes

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: D-11-A — report `PARTIAL_BOUNDARY` until compressor bus draw and valve-outlet feed state are measured/provided by ICD. Do not insert guessed fixed loads.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: compressor TBD -> ledger status PARTIAL_BOUNDARY; no guessed fixed load

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: NEW `NET_BENEFIT` form — hard gates + Pareto, not a weighted score. ICP must meet electron-current/neutralization, thrust, full P_bus, stability and safety gates; then report ΔXe, ΔP_bus, Δmass, T/P_bus, restart and life burden relative to C1. No single scalar winner unless preregistered.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: the ledger reports per-slot P_bus for Delta P_bus in NET_BENEFIT; no weighted scalar is formed

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: `OPEN` is a status, not an outcome. If evidence cannot decide, report unresolved and identify the next discriminating test.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: NOT_EVALUABLE / OPEN are statuses, not outcomes

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: `PHASE_TOTAL_FLOW` — book all Xe during purge, preheat, ignition, keeper/cathode operation, transition and fallback. No unbooked preheat flow.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: sequence steps with Xe flow (purge, preheat, ignition) are flagged for PHASE_TOTAL_FLOW booking

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: 15,000 h for the conventional C1 reference/fallback term. The ICP-neutralizer architecture has no continuous C1-Xe cathode term, but must carry its own RF-neutralizer lifetime/cycle requirement.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: hall_icp_neutralizer has no C1 slots; its dedicated gas feed slot flow_control_icp_feed is installed only in a declared G-ATM / G-XE variant (A9.1 HIQ-06: G-REUSE primary, no dedicated feed)

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: YES if the C1/Xe branch remains in scope — include the filter/getter with explicit ≤17 W-class load only after vendor/spec verification; account its mass and pressure drop. It is not required for an ICP-only flight branch.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: filter_getter slot exists only in hall_c1_reference; value TBD until vendor/spec verification

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — use a v0 dry-mass budget against a 28 kg dry target: intake/filter/duct 3.5 kg; compressor+drive 5.5; plenum/feed 1.0; Hall head+magnet 3.0; ICP neutralizer 2.0; RF generator/matching 1.5; Hall PPU 2.5; Xe hardware 1.5; controls/harness 1.0; structure/thermal 2.5. Sum 24 kg, leaving 4 kg dry development reserve. These are allocations, not CBEs.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: v0 dry allocations passed to H2-7 as allocations, not CBEs: electronics lines (RF generator/matching 1.5 kg, Hall PPU 2.5 kg, controls/harness 1.0 kg) and, separately, the ICP neutralizer source head (2.0 kg, not electronics)

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: LIMITED redundancy — dual series isolation on the high-pressure Xe path plus critical sensing/FDIR redundancy; do not duplicate the thruster, ICP neutralizer or full PPU at this stage. Revisit after failure-tree evidence.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: H2-4 H24-35 (no single-point failure) flagged CONSTRAINED_BY_OWNER_ANSWER: limited redundancy, no full-PPU duplication; redundancy affects PPU mass, not the per-slot P_bus rule

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: NO as a CBE — NASA SBIR 2 kg PPU may remain an aspirational/screening low end only. It cannot be used as demonstrated mass evidence.
owner_answers_applied.how_applied: SBIR 2 kg PPU is not used as mass evidence

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: ACCEPT with A9 amendment — add downstream ICP neutralizer, RF generator/matching/feedthrough and collector/bias hardware; retain C1 as reference/fallback. Remove pre-ionizer-only items from the new architecture BOM, not from historical v1.

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: NEW BUS-BOUNDARY VERSION — do not prohibit legitimate loads. Add explicit components for RF source/matching, collector/bias supply, any assist magnet and active cooling if used.

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: OLD options are not adequate. Keep the ICP dielectric/body floating unless the validated circuit requires otherwise; control and measure the electron-extraction collector bias separately. Do not hard-ground the plasma body by default.

owner_answers_applied.owner_answer_verbatim: YES — provide current-limited pulsed keeper ignition capability in the 300–600 V class for C1 development/reference testing, with interlocks and recorded pulse energy.

open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: OQ-A902-02: 300 W common allocation = compressor + atm/Xe/ICP flow-control + filter/getter if active + thermal control + housekeeping/controls; 50 W controls/thermal inside it; extra active cooling and reserved ports outside unless reallocated

open_owner_questions.question: Sub-allocation of the 1350 W design allocation between Hall discharge, magnets and the electron source (C1 reference supplies vs ICP RF/matching/collector)?
open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: OQ-A902-03: no fixed Hall/ICP split; P_ICP,available = 1350 - P_common - P_Hall - P_other_active at every registered condition; ICP-45 demonstrated within it; 0-500 W lab RF is a test capability only

open_owner_questions.question: Is a combined 'ICP + C1 backup' flight variant (both electron sources installed) in scope? Row 55 excludes duplicating the ICP, and says nothing on a C1 backup.
open_owner_questions.proposed_answer: owner call (not declared in bus_power_boundary_a9_v1; would be a new declared variant)
open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: OQ-A902-04: no combined flight C1 + ICP installation in primary A9 (would be a new variant with its own closures)

open_owner_questions.question: Which gas and source feed the ICP (Xe ledger or atmospheric feed), and does its valve sit in the common allocation (row 46 recorder flag)?
open_owner_questions.proposed_answer: PROPOSED: book the valve under flow_control_icp_feed inside the common allocation; species owner call
open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: OQ-A902-05: primary G-REUSE; flow_control_icp_feed booked only when G-ATM or G-XE is installed/used; capped port stays in the ICD

open_owner_questions.question: Are housekeeping/controls and thermal loads fed through the 100 V internal bus or directly from the spacecraft input?
open_owner_questions.proposed_answer: PROPOSED: through the internal bus unless the PPU design states otherwise; the path is an explicit ledger input either way
open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: OQ-A902-06: housekeeping and thermal routed through the internal propulsion bus by default; any direct spacecraft-input path represented explicitly

open_owner_questions.question: Should the design-allocation check also be reported at the A5 lower end (1300 W)?
open_owner_questions.proposed_answer: PROPOSED: yes, as context only; row 109's ~1.35 kW is the check limit
open_owner_questions.a9_1_decision: OQ-A902-07: report 1300 W as context/sensitivity; active internal check 1350 W; hard requirement 1500 W
